messages:
jess (platform-eng): heads up — noticed exporter pod for otel-exporter-1 spiking mem and sustained queue growth after the tiered-sampling rollout last night. Metrics: exporter_queue_len ~ 1200, mem 4.2Gi.

matt (eng-sre): ouch. any error logs? OOMs? @olga

jess (platform-eng): no OOMs yet, just long GC. logs show backpressure: "exporter queue full, dropping spans" then retries piling up. suspect aggregator window/batch size + sampling policy mismatch.

olga (eng-platform): could be head/tail logic creating big reservoirs for low-tier routes — they keep buffering full traces. what are the sampling settings?

jess (platform-eng): current OTEL config (simplified):
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: otel-collector:55680
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, tail_sampler]
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 200
  tail_sampler:
    policy: head_tail_mixed
    tail_size: 2000
    head_rate: 0.02
```

priya (eng-platform): tail_size 2000 seems high for tiered routes. for low-tier customers we should cap reservoir per-route. otherwise a single noisy tenant consumes memory.

sam (observability): agree. we have two knobs in console: sampling by route tier and global reservoir cap. but UI rollout was conservative — we didn't add per-exporter memory throttle.

jess (platform-eng): proposal: add exporter-level queue soft limit + circuit-breaker that switches policy to probabilistic sampling when queue > 70%.

olga (eng-platform): +1. Also consider moving batch timeout down to 1s for internal exporters and decrease batch size. That reduces latency and memory.

priya (eng-platform): UX: console needs a toggle for "auto-fallback sampling" with explanation of behavior and metric links. teams should be able to pin per-route policy.

matt (eng-sre): ops: add an alert when exporter_queue_len > 500 and mem > 3Gi; temporary mitigation runbook: restart exporter, flip to probabilistic, and enable dryer batch.

telemetry-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-254 exporter queue pressure on otel-collector. Assigned: matt, jess

jess (platform-eng): I'll draft a quick RFC for the fallback circuit-breaker + per-exporter mem cap. pushing PR for smaller batch settings now. cc @priya for console UX copy.

priya (eng-platform): thanks. I'll mock the toggle and tooltip. can we also surface per-route reservoir usage in Console traces dashboard?

sam (observability): yes — add per-route reservoir graph and exporter queue heatmap. that'll help customers identify noisy tenants.

jess (platform-eng): perfect. timeline: tiny fix (batch size+timeout) in next deploy window (today), RFC for circuit-breaker by EOD tomorrow, console mock by next week.

olga (eng-platform): sounds good. :thumbsup:

matt (eng-sre): ping if you want help with runbook steps.
